description: Kubernetes 1.28 'Planternetes' 🌱 cultivates 45 enhancements with the care of a master gardener. Like tending a thriving garden, this release nurtures native sidecar containers (alpha), extends the supported version skew to n-3 for more flexible upgrades, and brings non-graceful node shutdown recovery to stable bloom. The community planted seeds of innovation across CDI injection, job tracking, and mixed version proxy—each feature carefully grown to harmonious maturity.

features.title: Support Oldest Node And Newest Control Plane
